turns.question: How many orders of more than 100 EUR were placed on 1 and 2 October 2026?
turns.answer: 6 orders of more than 100 EUR were placed over 1 to 2 October 2026 (cancelled orders included, as the Orders metric counts all orders placed). Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
